name: Uriah (the priest)
title: High Priest under King Ahaz
summary: Uriah was high priest under King Ahaz. He was one of Isaiah's witnesses, but he also built a pagan altar after the model from Damascus at the king's command—a sign of Ahaz's apostasy.

keyEvents.title: Builds an altar according to the king's wish
keyEvents.description: Uriah the priest built an altar after the pattern from Damascus as King Ahaz had commanded.
